IBM Ponder This July 2010

A rounding problem becomes a congruence problem through algebraic traces, recurrences, and a companion matrix.

This solution to the July 2010 IBM Ponder This challenge moves between algebraic numbers and finite arithmetic. Traces provide an integer recurrence, and a companion matrix organizes the modular calculation.

Background

Algebraic numbers, polynomial roots, and modular arithmetic.
